page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening). Running head at top, page number at top right. Main text in one column with a woodcut initial. Margin notes at the right margin: "Pono, uel ponor." beside the Imperfectum line; "Notio augmenti." beside the "Scindum" paragraph. Signature mark at foot.

main_text.head: MEDIVM VERBVM IN μι sic colligitur.
main_text.p: DEINDE, si lubet, medium uerbum sic colligito, Præsens τί-θεμαι. Imperfectum ἐτιθέμην, Pono, uel ponor. Perfectum & plusquamperfectum medium in uerbis in μι desunt. In finitum primum ἐθηκάμην, ab ἔθηκα, sicut ἐτυψάμην ab ἔτυψα. Infinitum secundum uocalem indicem resoluit ἐθέμην, ab ἔθω, sicut ἐτυπόμην ab ἔτυπον, ἐςάμην, ἐδόμην, secunda persona ἔθετο uel ἔθου, ἔθετο, tertia ἐθέτο, &c. per reliquos modos flectitur ut Præsens reduplicatione remota. Futurum primum θήσομαι à θήω, flectitur sicut τύψομαι. Secundum desyderatur.
main_text.head: DE VERBIS COPIOSIVS.
main_text.p: SCIENDVM præter ea quæ iam de augmento dicta sunt, quod uerbum cum prepositione compositum, no plus significans quam simplex, augetur in principio totius compositi, ut ἔτω dico, componitur cum ἐν, & idem signifi-Notio augmenti.

page.notes: Woodcut initial D. Greek words printed in Greek letters; diacritics as best read. Several Greek forms are uncertain and not marked.
